editorial: Shrek Forever After manages to elevate its fairytale status, transforming a simple animated comedy into a surprisingly poignant exploration of growing up and finding your happily ever after. When a life-altering gamble throws Shrek into a nightmare version of Far Far Away, he must fight not only a sinister villain but also the crushing weight of disappointment. It’s a heartfelt, action-packed adventure that proves the heart of the ogre never loses its magic.
